name: PT Bach Multi Global Tbk.
summary: PT Bach Multi Global Tbk. provides power system solutions and telecommunication infrastructure construction and maintenance services. The company operates in two segments, Sales and Rental of Generators and Telecommunication Infrastructure Construction and Maintenance Services. The Sales and Rental of Generators segment engages in the supply, installation, and after-sales service of generators under the Himoinsa and other brands; and provision of generator rental services. The Telecommunication Infrastructure Construction and Maintenance Services segment constructs BTS towers and fiber optic networks, including site acquisition, civil, mechanical, and electrical works.
